about_the_game:
Welcome to the absurd world of the parody horror game “YetiParty.”

  • Get ready for an unmatched walking simulator set in a Russian village (now with a pinch of realism!).

  • You can pick up items and carry them in your hands — revolutionary gameplay.

  • Some assets you've definitely never seen in other games (but let’s be honest — you probably have).

  • Built on Unreal Engine 5, which, surprisingly, didn’t improve the quality at all.

You play as a first-year student named Pyodor. His parents couldn’t choose between Fyodor and Pyotr, so they went with a compromise. To celebrate getting into university, Pyodor and his friends head to a remote Russian village to party. But things take a turn when an ancient evil awakens deep in the forest… Oh, and three local thugs really want to steal your phone.

Feed the rabbits, grab some beers, and maybe try to lose your virginity to your friend’s hot sister. Otherwise, a bloodthirsty Yeti might mount you on his hairy… you know what. So party hard — before night falls.

Game Features

(Yes, it’s actually... special.)

  • Low-effort jokes and filthy punchlines written by wannabe Tarantinos.

  • A cutting-edge dialogue system that affects absolutely nothing.

  • You'll laugh. You'll scream. It’s like two games for the price of one.

  • Ancient memes, loud profanity, and proudly dumb stereotypes.

  • A killer soundtrack featuring such legendary hits as:
    “And the Cranes Flew Over the River Outpost”
    “My Python Is Ready for Love”
    “18 Seconds of Passion”

As a bonus, the game also includes:

1) Cringe-worthy Russian voice acting.

2) Plot twists straight out of DuckTales.

3) A chance to fix Uncle Kolya’s car (whoever the hell that is).

4) A good ol’ punch in the face!

But the most important thing is the story that YetiParty has to offer.

A coming-of-age tale. A story of love. A story of life itself...

Who are we kidding — it’s pure chaos and unfiltered degeneracy!
You’ve been warned.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains images of violence that may have a negative impact on the psyche. Some content elements may not be suitable for certain age groups. Reasonable limitation of the game's audience is recommended. There are rude jokes and foul language.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11 (64-BIT)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 2GB / AMD Radeon R9 280 3GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11 (64-BIT)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 480 with 3GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A first-person parody horror. College goofballs are partying hard in the great outdoors - booze, boobs, and bad decisions. What's gonna kill 'em first? Cheap vodka, ancient memes, dirty jokes… or a bloodthirsty Yeti from the woods?
